scheme_name: Building and Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Welfare Fund
eligibility_text: Construction workers (masons, painters, electricians, plumbers, welders, loaders, etc.) who have worked at least 90 days in the preceding year, registered with their state's Labour Department BOCW Welfare Board.
benefits: State-run welfare fund financed by a 1% cess on construction cost; typical benefits include accident assistance, disability pension, maternity benefit, and education scholarships for children — exact benefits and amounts vary by state.
source_note: Structure is central law (BOCW Act, 1996) but benefits are state-administered — use your state's specific labour department portal for exact figures.
